name: commit-video-tools
description: Regenerates the ad's phone screens and screen-recording from the real app.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.all: npm run screens && npm run record && npm run films
scripts.mp4-flow: ffmpeg -y -i clips/flow.webm -vf fps=30,scale=720:-2 -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart films/app-flow.mp4
